card.name: Inside words starting with anti-
card.fires_on: The piece of a word right after the prefix anti- or ant-, such as antiem|etics, ANTI|H|ISTAMINES, antim|y|asthenics. Also seen in abiotic.

modes.label: Antiemetic and antihistamine
modes.description: Later pieces of anti- drug class words, in running text or in capitals.

modes.label: Other anti- words
modes.description: Middle piece of other rare anti- or a- words.

card.writes: The suppressed and promoted tokens are mixed word pieces, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires partway through long anti- drug class words like antiemetics and antihistamines.
